description: This file defines the LeaveTypeService class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It manages leave type data, providing methods to retrieve eligible leave types, convert leave type objects to arrays, and initialize the LeaveTypeDao. It utilizes various traits for normalization, internationalization, and leave entitlement services, indicating it's part of the business logic layer related to leave types.

classes.name: LeaveTypeService
classes.description: A service class for handling leave type operations including fetching eligible leave types, retrieving leave type info as an array, and initializing the DAO object.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LeaveTypeDao object used to interact with leave type data in the database.

methods.name: getEligibleLeaveTypesByEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of LeaveType objects that an employee with the given employee number is eligible for, optionally including those with allocated leaves.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Retrieves leave type information by ID and returns it as an array suitable for presentation, marking deleted types appropriately.
